The protagonist confesses his feelings to his childhood friend, a hot-headed blonde, and gets a positive response, leading to his first sexual encounter with her!

It’s all smooth sailing! Feeling unstoppable, the protagonist rushes into his house and begs his strong-willed, black-haired sister, who treats him like a sex toy, to end their relationship, but she ends up straddling him right there!

item.title: Hirogaru Sora no Katasumi no
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: GOOD DAYS MAKER
  • 発売日: 2011-05-05
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 広がる空の片隅の
  • 英語名: Hirogaru Sora no Katasumi no

あらすじ

Living in a rural town where only a dozen or so trains run daily, our protagonist leads a carefree life on his own, despite being occasionally pushed around by his eccentric father, who travels abroad for work.

Then, in a sudden phone call from his father, he learns that he has a new “stepsister.” What’s more, this out-of-nowhere stepsister will be arriving at the nearest station in about five minutes. Rushing to pick her up, unable to organize his thoughts, our protagonist meets a girl there.
